chapters.label: Live: the 2019 semi-final
chapters.text: Almaty, 2019, the European futsal semi-final. Sporting lead Inter four to two, with seconds left. Then Cardinal scores! Five two!

chapters.label: How he does it
chapters.text: Here is how he does it. He keeps moving between the defenders. The pass comes across the box, and he arrives at the back post. Goal!

chapters.label: Replay: the blind side
chapters.text: Again, slowly. The defenders watch the ball. Cardinal slips behind them to the back post, where nobody is looking. Free! One touch, and in.

chapters.label: Practise it
chapters.text: Your turn: keep moving between defenders, so you are free when the pass comes!
